verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents AI-powered semantic extraction (`ai_query`, `ai_extract_rules`) and pass-through ChatGPT and Gemini APIs. These pull fields from web pages or relay prompts to an LLM. None of them is a feature that analyzes the user's data inside the product and returns insights or suggestions. That makes them adjacent building blocks or different features, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
